punchline: When senior leaders listed what blocks courage at work, the number one item was the tough conversations they themselves avoid.
thirty_sec: Brené Brown's team asked 150 senior leaders what has to change about leadership. Their answer: we need braver leaders. Then they listed what gets in the way, and at the top was avoiding tough conversations, including honest feedback. Some blamed a lack of courage, some a lack of skills, and more than half said their culture of being nice and polite was the excuse. Brown's reply fits in four words each: clear is kind, unclear is unkind.
